comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Alex, 2026-10-05: a zoom should fill the whole tab, whatever daemons its panes are on.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-05 on 0.13.0: a tab holding one laptop pane (left region) and two devenv panes (right region). Zooming the laptop pane (cmd+shift+enter) filled only the laptop region; the devenv region kept showing both its panes beside it. Alex expected the zoomed pane to fill the tab, as it does in a one-machine tab.

Why: zoom is recorded per daemon, on that daemon's part of the tab, and `View::built` resolves each region on its own: `zoom_filling(region, layout)` checks only that region's daemon's `layout.zoomed` (crates/muster-core/src/composition/view.rs). Nothing hides the other regions, so a zoom never crosses a machine.

Likely fix: when the region holding the keyboard (`held.focused_region()`) is zoomed, the view shows that region alone, and the others keep their trees and surfaces as a covered pane does (`showing` would mark their panes hidden, so the hidden-pane notifications in a_2J1KZe2ws apply). Unzooming restores the regions at their weights. docs/cli/limits.md says nothing about zoom across regions today; it should either way.
title: 🔍 Zooming a pane in a mixed-machine tab zooms only its machine's region
